title: Luxurious Fermented Irish Lamb Stew
description: A rich and velvety Irish stew featuring fermented lamb, mustard seeds, and ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a kazan cauldron.
instructions: Heat the kazan cauldron over medium heat and add the mustard seeds to toast for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped onions, carrots, celery, and garlic to the cauldron and saute for 10 minutes.
Add the fermented lamb shoulder to the cauldron and cook for 5 minutes on each side.
Add the lamb broth, apple cider vinegar, and chopped parsley to the cauldron and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.
Add the potatoes to the cauldron and continue to simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
